title: 第二章 蛇鞭无情 芳心有意第三章 邪物初现 浩劫即来
content_zh:
“啪”一声鞭吟，碎屑纷飞，男孩的肩头袭来阵阵戳骨般的疼痛，扭头回看，只见一道血痕如同锋利刀刃划过肌肤一般硬生生地印在男孩左肩。男孩呲牙咧嘴，疼得直哼哼。然而他自己却倔着一口气，强自扭过头来不愿出声，更不愿再抬头看女孩一眼。
黑衣骑客本欲上前阻止，而此时女孩愠怒的表情，以及哽咽的呼喊声竟把他顿时化为了雕塑，僵在了那里，不知所措。女孩近乎发疯的样子，他还是头一次见，黑衣骑客想到这里不禁撰了撰拳头。“哎，少主也的确可怜，不能像同年纪的其他孩子一样。竟没有一个玩伴，着实苦了她......”
女孩呆呆地看着这个如此倔强的男孩，是第一次，一种挫败感涌上了心头。“我就不信，为什么？为什么？”因为在宫中的任何一个人，当面对她的颐指气使、飞扬跋扈都会低头认错，诺诺称是。从来没有一个人敢对她爱理不理，敬之不恭。她是如此地无奈，以至于她觉得自己在这个小子面前竟让她感到束手无策。
“啾啾”几声欢快的鸟叫声赶走了越来越稀薄的雾气，迷迷瞪瞪的世界逐渐鲜亮了起来。古道林间，几只麻雀撺掇在层层密林之中，时而探头露脑，时而晃动着胖乎乎的身体来回跳跃。仿似这里紧张的气氛根本影响不了他们的天真烂漫。
就在这时，一只不识趣的麻雀扑棱棱地低低掠过，阳光在林间倾泻而下，被叶子剪碎的阳光便如同细沙一般轻洒在了麻雀身上。这只鸟儿呢啾盘旋，惬意的享受着这一切，却不知道一场厄运即将到来。就在鸟儿低飞过女孩头顶的那一瞬，“啾啾”的鸟叫声将女孩从臆想中惊醒。她纤手一扬，青蛇鞭迅疾地盘旋而上，一道诡异的弧线向鸟儿荡去。“叽”地一声惨叫，鸟儿如同消失劲力的沙包一般直直地坠下，翻滚在地，连挣扎都没有便没有了气息。
“你这个疯丫头！”男孩抢步，飞也似的奔了过去。他双手颤抖着，轻轻地将小鸟捧起。刚刚还一脸满不在乎的他，此刻却在其眼角挂着一滴晶莹的泪珠。男孩恶狠狠地瞪了女孩一眼，像极了一头发怒的小豹。而女孩霎时之间彷如电击般地愣在了那里，痴痴地看着男孩轻轻地抚摸着小鸟的身体，一声一声地呼喊着“雀儿，雀儿，你快醒醒啊！”
刚才男孩的眼神里面满是仇恨与不屑，目睹其眼神的女孩心里再次莫名地一颤，那种感觉不仅仅是触动了下，而且好像很疼很疼的样子。“他宁愿去理会一只小鸟，也不愿意理我。”女孩的眼泪吧嗒吧嗒地往下掉。“你这个疯丫头！”、“你这个疯丫头！”......那句话在她心里面回荡萦绕，久久不绝。她感觉自己的内心憋得愈来愈厉害，越来越难受，她快承受不了了，迷迷糊糊之间，猛地将双手一提，想要摆脱什么似得将青蛇鞭大力抛掉。然后猛地闭上双眼，双手紧紧地抚在了胸口......渐渐地，气息平定了下来，她长出了一口气。
“咱们走吧，赶路要紧。”女孩缓缓起身，牵过马绳。黑衣骑客闻声不由得愣了一下，他快速地忽闪了下眼睛，像找回魂一样难以置信的瞅着女孩战战兢兢地说道：“嗯，嗯，好的、好的。”女孩左手提裙，白衣一荡，便跃上马来。
“这小子.......”黑衣骑客咳嗽了一下，故作镇定地问道。
“哼！”不等他说完，女孩便咬咬嘴唇说道：“这贼小子，不理他便是了。”
“对、对，呵呵。”黑衣骑客干笑一声。
话虽如此，女孩撅着嘴巴却不由自主地向男孩瞟了过去。只见那个男孩手捧小鸟，一脸的难受，仿似有说不完的伤心。那个摸样瞧着就像手捧着一件珍贵的瓷器一般，摸了一遍又一遍。
女孩拨转马头，默默起身。“这个小子，人倒也不错，又有趣又心眼好，只可惜......，是我不好。”她嚼着这句话，轻轻地叹了口气，继续催马前行。而黑衣骑客闻声后，捻捻颔下燕须，会意地一笑。
劲蹄扬沙，马声渐远。两条身影渐渐地消失在了古道尽头。
男孩站起身来，看了看他们远去的身影，边拭着泪边又骂了一句：“疯丫头！”待他回过神来，却“啊”地一声喊了出来。原来，肩头的鲜血正“滴答滴答”地往下滴，不经意间已染红了整个肩头，而此时一阵火辣辣的疼痛正如撕心裂肺一般直窜骨髓！“疼死我了！”他咬牙切齿地说道。
“咦，那是什么？”
content_en:
"Crack" was heard as the whip roared, debris flew into the air, and waves of bone-piercing pain hit the boy's shoulder. He turned his head and looked back, only to see a bloodstain imprinted on the boy's left shoulder like a sharp blade cutting across the skin. The boy grinned and groaned in pain. However, he took a stubborn breath and forced himself to turn his head, not wanting to make a sound, let alone look up at the girl again.
The black-clothed knight was about to step forward to stop him, but at this moment the girl's sullen expression and choked shouts turned him into a sculpture, and he froze there, at a loss. This was the first time he had seen a girl almost going crazy. The knight in black couldn't help but clench his fists when he thought of this. "Hey, the young master is indeed pitiful. She can't be like other children of the same age. She doesn't have a playmate, which really hurts her..."
The girl stared blankly at this stubborn boy. For the first time, a sense of frustration came to her heart. "I don't believe it, why? Why?" Because anyone in the palace would bow their heads and admit their mistakes when faced with her bossiness and domineering attitude. Nono said so. No one has ever dared to ignore or disrespect her. She was so helpless that she felt that she was helpless in front of this boy.
"Chirp chirp" A few cheerful bird calls drove away the increasingly thin fog, and the dazed world gradually became brighter. In the ancient forest, a few sparrows fluttered among the layers of dense forest. Sometimes they poked their heads out, and sometimes they jumped back and forth with their chubby bodies shaking. It seems that the tense atmosphere here cannot affect their innocence at all.
At this moment, an ignorant sparrow fluttered low and low, and the sunlight poured down in the forest. The sunlight cut by the leaves sprinkled lightly on the sparrow like fine sand. The bird was chirping and circling, enjoying everything comfortably, but it had no idea that a bad luck was about to come. The moment the bird flew low over the girl's head, the chirping of the bird woke the girl up from her reverie. She raised her delicate hand, and the green snake whip quickly circled upwards, swinging toward the bird in a weird arc. With a scream of "chie", the bird fell straight down like a sandbag that had lost its strength, rolled to the ground, and lost its breath without even struggling.
"You crazy girl!" The boy rushed over as fast as he could. With trembling hands, he gently picked up the bird. He looked indifferent just now, but now there was a crystal tear hanging in the corner of his eye. The boy glared at the girl fiercely, like an angry little leopard. The girl froze there for an instant, as if she had received an electric shock. She looked at the boy gently caressing the bird's body, calling out again and again, "Quieer, Queer, wake up quickly!"
The boy's eyes just now were full of hatred and disdain. The girl who saw his eyes trembled inexplicably again. The feeling was not only touching, but also painful. "He would rather pay attention to a little bird than to me." The girl's tears fell down. "You crazy girl!", "You crazy girl!"... Those words echoed in her heart for a long time. She felt that the suffocation in her heart was getting more and more severe, and she was getting more and more uncomfortable. She could hardly bear it anymore. In a daze, she suddenly raised her hands and threw the green snake whip away as if she wanted to get rid of something. Then she closed her eyes suddenly and put her hands on her chest tightly... Gradually, her breath calmed down and she took a deep breath.
"Let's go, we have to hurry." The girl stood up slowly and took the horse's rope. The knight in black couldn't help but froze for a moment when he heard the sound. He quickly blinked his eyes, looked at the girl in disbelief as if he had regained his soul, and said tremblingly: "Yeah, um, okay, okay." The girl held up her skirt in her left hand, swung her white clothes, and jumped onto the horse.
"This kid..."The knight in black coughed and asked pretending to be calm.
"Hmph! Before he could finish speaking, the girl bit her lips and said, "This thief, just ignore him." "
“Yes, yes, haha. "The knight in black laughed dryly.
Having said that, the girl pouted and glanced at the boy involuntarily. I saw the boy holding the bird in his hand, with a sad look on his face, as if he was filled with endless sadness. The touch looked like holding a piece of precious porcelain in one's hand, and it was touched over and over again.
The girl turned the horse's head and stood up silently. "This kid is quite a nice person, interesting and kind-hearted, but unfortunately... it's my fault. " She chewed these words, sighed softly, and continued to urge the horse forward. After hearing the sound, the knight in black twirled his whiskers and smiled knowingly.
The sound of strong hooves blows up the sand, and the sound of horses gradually fades away. The two figures gradually disappeared at the end of the ancient road.
The boy stood up, looked at their retreating figures, wiped his tears and cursed again: "Crazy girl! "When he came to his senses, he shouted "ah". It turned out that the blood on his shoulder was dripping down, and it had inadvertently dyed the entire shoulder red. At this time, a burning pain went straight to the bone marrow like a heartbreaking! "It hurts me to death!" "He said through gritted teeth.
"Hey, what is that? "
